action.description: inspect: a public Instagram post's structure (hook pattern, beats and timing, format, text density, pacing, proof, CTA) and a plan to remake it for the brand. recreate: run that plan; without mode='confirm' it previews the cost and returns a confirm_token.

url.description: inspect: the post link. Pass a public Instagram post or reel link: https://www.instagram.com/p/<code>/, /reel/<code>/ or /reels/<code>/.

plan.description: recreate: the plan inspect returned, unchanged (the confirm_token is bound to it).

max_usd.description: recreate confirm: the most it may spend in USD; required when the preview says requires_max_usd. Refused before any spend when the engine’s own cap is higher.

footage_asset_ids.description: recreate confirm of a footage_edit plan: the brand's own Library videos of the brief's beats (upload them with media_upload_and_clip).
